story_description: As a user installing agentic coding CLIs, I need a clear visual progress view during installation so that I can monitor progress, understand what is happening, and cancel if needed.
task_description: Create InstallationProgressView SwiftUI component that displays step-by-step installation progress for CLI packages with cancel functionality, elapsed time, output log streaming, and error state handling.
atom_description: Implement a SwiftUI view that renders real-time CLI installation progress including: current step indicator with checkmarks for completed steps, animated progress bar for current operation, streaming terminal output preview, elapsed time counter, cancel button with confirmation, error state display with retry option, and success completion state with celebration animation.
problem_statement: During CLI installation which can take 30-120 seconds depending on network speed and package size, users need visual feedback to understand installation progress, see what step is currently executing, monitor for errors, and have the ability to cancel a stalled or unwanted installation. Without this view, users would see a blank or spinning state with no indication of progress or ability to intervene.

Progress step list showing all installation phases with visual state indicators (pending, active, completed, failed)
Animated progress bar for current active step with indeterminate mode for unknown duration operations
Terminal output preview showing last 10 lines of stdout/stderr from installation process
Elapsed time display with live updating timer showing MM:SS format
Cancel button that triggers confirmation alert before stopping installation
Error state view showing error message, failed step, and retry button
Success state view with checkmark animation and 'Continue' button
Accessibility labels for VoiceOver announcing progress changes and step completion
Keyboard shortcut Cmd+. to trigger cancel confirmation
scope_out: Actual process spawning and management - handled by CLIInstallationService (C002-SERVICE)
Installation state machine logic - handled by CLIInstallationState (C003-STATE)
CLI detection logic - handled by CLIInstallationService
Parent view orchestration - handled by OnboardingCLISetupView (C004-VIEW)
Network error handling and retries - handled by CLIInstallationService
Dependency resolution (checking Node.js, Python presence) - handled by CLIInstallationService

assumptions: InstallProgress struct exists from C003-STATE with currentStep, totalSteps, stepName, progress (0.0-1.0), output lines array, elapsedSeconds, and error optional
CLIInstallationService publishes progress updates via AsyncStream or Combine publisher
Cancel operation is handled by parent view through callback closure
Installation steps have predictable names that can be displayed to users
Terminal output is sanitized to remove ANSI escape codes before display
constraints: Must not block main thread - all progress updates via MainActor
View must update smoothly at 60fps even during rapid progress updates
Terminal output display limited to 10 lines to prevent memory bloat
Cancel confirmation must prevent accidental cancellation during long installs
Progress bar animation must be interruptible when progress jumps
Must work on macOS 14+ with @Observable pattern
Total view height must not exceed 400pt to fit within onboarding wizard bounds
functional_requirements: InstallationProgressView accepts InstallProgress Binding and onCancel closure as init parameters
View displays vertical list of installation steps derived from InstallProgress.steps array

Each step row shows: SF Symbol icon (circle for pending, arrow.circlepath for active, checkmark.circle.fill for completed, xmark.circle.fill for failed), step name text, and optional duration for completed steps
Currently active step row has highlighted background color and animated icon rotation
Progress bar below step list shows InstallProgress.progress value (0.0 to 1.0) or indeterminate animation if progress is nil
Terminal output section displays last 10 lines from InstallProgress.outputLines in monospace font with dark background
Elapsed time label updates every second showing format 'Elapsed: MM:SS'
Cancel button is always visible and enabled during active installation
Cancel button click shows confirmation alert with 'Cancel Installation' and 'Continue' options
Confirming cancel triggers onCancel closure callback
Error state replaces progress view when InstallProgress.error is non-nil
Error state shows error icon, error message, failed step name, and Retry button
Retry button click clears error and restarts installation via onRetry callback
Success state shows when InstallProgress.isComplete is true with no errors
Success state displays checkmark with scale animation, 'Installation Complete' message, and Continue button
Continue button triggers onComplete callback to advance wizard
nonfunctional_requirements: Progress bar animation uses spring timing with duration 0.3s for smooth updates
Step list updates trigger implicit animation with duration 0.25s
Timer updates at 1Hz frequency to show elapsed seconds
Terminal output scroll position auto-scrolls to bottom on new lines
Memory usage stays under 2MB even with 1000+ output lines (only last 10 displayed)
VoiceOver announces step changes with 0.5s debounce to prevent rapid-fire announcements
implementation_steps: Create Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Views/InstallationProgressView.swift file
Define InstallProgressStep struct with id, name, status enum (pending, active, completed, failed), duration optional
Define InstallProgress ObservableObject with steps array, currentStepIndex, progress Double optional, outputLines array, elapsedSeconds Int, error optional, isComplete Bool
Create InstallationProgressView struct with @Binding progress and callback closures
Implement stepRowView helper that renders single step with icon and text
Add conditional icon rendering based on step.status with rotation animation for active
Implement stepsListView using ForEach over progress.steps with stepRowView
Add ProgressView with progress.progress value or indeterminate style
Create terminalOutputView with ScrollView, monospace Text, dark background
Implement timerView with Text binding to progress.elapsedSeconds formatted as MM:SS
Add Timer publisher that updates elapsedSeconds every 1 second
Create cancelButton with Button and destructive role
Implement cancelConfirmationAlert modifier with .alert binding to showCancelConfirmation state
Create errorStateView with VStack containing error icon, message, step name, Retry button
Implement successStateView with checkmark icon, scale animation, message, Continue button
Compose main body with conditional rendering: errorStateView if error, successStateView if complete, else progressContentView
Add keyboard shortcut .cancelAction to cancel button
Add accessibility labels to all interactive elements
Add accessibility announcements for step status changes using AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
Write unit tests for progress state rendering
Write UI tests for cancel flow and error recovery
data_model_changes: Extend InstallProgress struct (from C003-STATE) to include outputLines: [String] array for terminal output
Add isComplete computed property to InstallProgress that returns true when all steps are completed status
Add formattedElapsedTime computed property returning MM:SS string from elapsedSeconds
api_contracts: InstallationProgressView.init(progress: Binding<InstallProgress>, onCancel: @escaping () -> Void, onRetry: @escaping () -> Void, onComplete: @escaping () -> Void)
InstallProgress.steps: [InstallProgressStep] - ordered array of installation steps
InstallProgress.currentStepIndex: Int - index of currently active step
InstallProgress.progress: Double? - 0.0 to 1.0 for current step, nil for indeterminate
InstallProgress.outputLines: [String] - terminal output lines (last N kept)
InstallProgress.elapsedSeconds: Int - seconds since installation started
InstallProgress.error: CLIInstallError? - error if installation failed
InstallProgress.isComplete: Bool - true when all steps completed successfully
InstallProgressStep.id: String - unique identifier for step
InstallProgressStep.name: String - display name for step
InstallProgressStep.status: StepStatus - pending, active, completed, or failed
InstallProgressStep.duration: TimeInterval? - seconds taken for completed steps
StepStatus enum: pending, active, completed, failed
event_contracts: installation_progress_viewed: Emitted when InstallationProgressView appears with { cli_type: String, total_steps: Int }
installation_step_started: Emitted when step status changes to active with { cli_type: String, step_name: String, step_index: Int }
installation_step_completed: Emitted when step status changes to completed with { cli_type: String, step_name: String, duration_seconds: Double }
installation_cancel_requested: Emitted when cancel button clicked (before confirmation) with { cli_type: String, elapsed_seconds: Int, current_step: String }
installation_cancel_confirmed: Emitted when cancel confirmed with { cli_type: String, elapsed_seconds: Int, current_step: String }
installation_cancel_dismissed: Emitted when cancel dismissed with { cli_type: String }
installation_error_displayed: Emitted when error state shown with { cli_type: String, error_type: String, error_message: String, failed_step: String }
installation_retry_clicked: Emitted when retry button clicked with { cli_type: String, error_type: String }
installation_completed: Emitted when success state shown with { cli_type: String, total_duration_seconds: Int, steps_count: Int }
ui_states: Initial loading state: progress.steps empty, indeterminate spinner, 'Preparing installation' text
Active installation state: steps list visible with current step highlighted, progress bar animating, terminal output streaming, timer counting
Step transition state: previous step shows checkmark with fade, current step highlights with spring animation
Indeterminate progress state: progress bar in indeterminate mode when progress value is nil
Determinate progress state: progress bar shows actual percentage when progress value is 0.0-1.0
Cancel confirmation state: alert overlay with 'Cancel Installation?' title and two buttons
Error state: error icon prominent, error message in red, failed step indicated, Retry button primary action
Success state: large checkmark with scale-in animation, 'Installation Complete' text, Continue button
Cancelled state: 'Installation Cancelled' message with option to retry or skip
ui_interactions: User views progress: steps list and progress bar update in real-time as installation proceeds
User scrolls terminal output: manual scroll overrides auto-scroll, releases to resume auto-scroll
User clicks Cancel: shows confirmation alert, does not stop installation yet
User confirms Cancel: triggers onCancel callback, parent stops installation process
User dismisses Cancel: alert closes, installation continues uninterrupted
User clicks Retry after error: triggers onRetry callback, error state clears, installation restarts
User clicks Continue after success: triggers onComplete callback, wizard advances to next screen
User presses Cmd+Period: equivalent to clicking Cancel button
VoiceOver user navigates: announces current step, progress percentage, elapsed time
ui_copy: Cancel alert message: 'The installation will be stopped. You can retry later from Settings.'
Success message: '{CLI name} is ready to use'
edge_cases: Installation completes faster than 1 second: timer shows 00:00, success state appears immediately
Progress jumps from 10% to 90%: animation interpolates smoothly without jarring jump
Terminal output has 10000+ lines: only last 10 displayed, no memory growth, scroll position maintained
Installation fails on first step: error state shows with step index 0, all steps show as pending except first
User cancels during final step: installation may complete before cancel processed, show appropriate state
Network disconnects mid-install: error state shows network error, retry button available
User rapidly clicks Cancel then dismisses: confirmation state handles rapid toggle without crash
View appears with already-completed progress: success state shown immediately without animation
View appears with already-failed progress: error state shown immediately
ElapsedSeconds overflows display: after 99:59, show 99:59+ instead of wrapping
failure_modes: Timer publisher not cancelled on view disappear: use .onDisappear to cancel timer subscription
Memory leak from output line accumulation: implement circular buffer with max 100 lines stored, 10 displayed
Animation stutter during rapid updates: batch progress updates with 100ms debounce
VoiceOver announcement spam: debounce announcements at 500ms minimum interval
Cancel callback not called: ensure onCancel is non-optional and always invoked on confirm
Progress binding update on background thread: force MainActor for all binding updates
Error state not shown: ensure error != nil check happens after progress update
rollback_plan: Remove InstallationProgressView.swift from Xcode project, remove import from OnboardingCLISetupView.swift, replace with simple ProgressView() spinner. No data model changes to reverse. Test files can be deleted.

completed_when: InstallationProgressView renders installation progress with animated steps, live timer, terminal output preview, and correctly handles cancel confirmation, error retry, and success completion flows.

dependencies: Requires InstallProgress model from C003-STATE. Requires integration point in OnboardingCLISetupView from C004-VIEW. Requires CLIInstallationService from C002-SERVICE to provide progress updates.
status_reason: UI component with well-defined inputs and outputs. Low risk as it is purely presentational with no side effects beyond callbacks.
open_questions: Should terminal output support horizontal scrolling for long lines or truncate with ellipsis?
Should elapsed time continue counting during error state or pause?
Should success animation play immediately or after short delay for user to see final state?
notes: This view is the primary user touchpoint during CLI installation. Quality of animations and responsiveness directly impacts perceived installation speed. Consider adding haptic feedback on completion for trackpad users.
verification_steps: Run 'swift test --filter InstallationProgressViewTests' and verify all tests pass
Open Xcode preview for InstallationProgressView and verify all states render correctly
Test cancel flow manually: click Cancel, verify alert appears, confirm cancel, verify callback triggered
Test error state: inject mock error, verify error view displays with retry button
Test success state: complete mock progress, verify checkmark animation and Continue button
Run VoiceOver and navigate through view, verify all elements announced correctly
Check Instruments for memory leaks during simulated long installation with many output lines

risks: Timer drift over long installations could show inaccurate elapsed time
Terminal output memory growth if circular buffer not implemented correctly
Animation stutter if progress updates faster than frame rate
Cancel callback could be triggered multiple times if user double-taps quickly
Accessibility announcements could be missed if debounce too aggressive
mitigations: Use Date-based elapsed time calculation rather than incrementing counter
Implement strict circular buffer with max 100 elements, test with 10000 updates
Debounce progress updates to max 60 per second, coalesce rapid updates
Disable cancel button immediately on tap, re-enable only after callback completes
Use 500ms debounce for VoiceOver but ensure critical state changes always announced
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to InstallationProgressView and its parent OnboardingCLISetupView. No impact on other onboarding screens, main app functionality, or data persistence. Failure results in poor UX but no data loss.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If view has critical issues, replace with simple ProgressView() indeterminate spinner and Text showing current step name. Users lose terminal output and cancel confirmation but installation still works.
